nodes.label: Raster Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Blue #5b8cff, green #4ade80, yellow #ffd166, pink #ff6b8b accents over dark #16171d and light text #f4f5f8; likely mirrors the app's UI theme tokens.

nodes.label: Pixel-Art 'R' Icon Mark
nodes.rationale: A 10x10 rounded dark tile (#16171d) containing a pixel 'R' drawn in four horizontal color bands (blue #5b8cff, green #4ade80, yellow #ffd166, pink #ff6b8b), evoking scanline/raster rows of a pixel editor.

nodes.label: Pixel 'Raster' Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Hand-placed pixel lettering spelling 'Raster' in near-white #f4f5f8, intended for display on dark backgrounds (dark-mode README/docs).

nodes.label: Crisp-Edges Pixel Rendering
nodes.rationale: The SVG uses shape-rendering="crispEdges" and integer-grid rects on a 43x10 viewBox scaled 12x, so the logo stays pixel-sharp at any size, matching the pixel-art identity of a raster/pixel editor.

nodes.label: Raster Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Four accent colors (#5b8cff blue, #4ade80 green, #ffd166 yellow, #ff6b8b pink) on dark base #16171d define the brand identity.

nodes.label: Raster Logo (Light Variant)
nodes.rationale: Light-background variant of the project logo: wordmark drawn in near-black #16171d so it reads on light themes (e.g. GitHub light README). Built entirely from 1-unit rects with shape-rendering=crispEdges so it stays pixel-sharp at any scale, reflecting the pixel-art nature of the Raster editor.

nodes.label: Pixel-Art R App Icon Mark
nodes.rationale: 10x10 dark rounded square containing a pixel-drawn letter R striped in four horizontal color bands (blue #5b8cff, green #4ade80, yellow #ffd166, pink #ff6b8b), evoking a raster/scanline pixel grid.

nodes.label: Raster Pixel Wordmark
nodes.rationale: The word 'Raster' set in a hand-built 7px-tall bitmap font, scaled 6/7 to align with the icon mark.

nodes.label: Crisp-Edges Pixel Rendering
nodes.rationale: shape-rendering=crispEdges with integer-grid rects prevents anti-aliasing so the vector logo renders as hard-edged pixel art.

nodes.rationale: Bumps package.json/lockfile and dates the changelog but does not commit or tag, so the maintainer reviews first.

nodes.label: Cel (base64 raw RGBA per frame)
nodes.rationale: Each cel decodes to width x height x 4 bytes with straight (not premultiplied) alpha.

nodes.norm_label: threat model: crafted files and file system escape

nodes.label: .raster File Format (v2 JSON)
nodes.rationale: UTF-8 JSON with base64 RGBA cels; view settings and reference image deliberately not saved.

nodes.label: Raster Pixel Art Editor
nodes.rationale: Fast, focused desktop editor that works offline, needs no account, and keeps work on the user's machine.

nodes.label: Layers Hold One Cel per Frame
nodes.norm_label: layers hold one cel per frame
nodes.rationale: layer.pixels points at the current frame's cel so tools never deal with frames; undo records the frame.

nodes.label: Code Layering (core / editor / ui / electron)
nodes.rationale: core is pure TypeScript with no DOM/React and fully unit tested; editor is framework-free where possible; ui holds React; electron is the desktop shell.

nodes.label: Colors as 32-bit RGBA Numbers
nodes.rationale: Byte order matches ImageData so Uint32Array layer buffers can be blitted directly.

nodes.label: Editor as Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: editor as single source of truth
nodes.rationale: UI reads immutable EditorState snapshots via useEditorState(selector); pixel data mutated in place and state.revision bumps.

nodes.label: Selections Clip Strokes and Float When Moved
nodes.norm_label: selections clip strokes and float when moved
nodes.rationale: Floating buffer is committed by settle() as one undo step before any other document change.

nodes.label: Sandboxed Page with window.raster Bridge
nodes.rationale: Page has no Node access; file system access goes through window.raster and the main process only writes files the user picked or opened.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning Policy
nodes.rationale: Before 1.0 minor versions may break; app version and .raster format version are independent.

nodes.label: Every Document Change Is Undoable (sparse diff / Command)
nodes.norm_label: every document change is undoable (sparse diff / command)
nodes.rationale: Pixel edits go beginStroke -> dab/fill -> endStroke storing a sparse diff; structural changes push a Command with undo/redo.

nodes.label: Format Versioning and Backward Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Any format change must bump version and keep reading older files; readers refuse newer versions.

nodes.label: Unsigned Installer / SmartScreen Warning
nodes.rationale: No paid code-signing certificate yet; authenticity is established by building releases from public source via GitHub Actions.
